scope: Additional statistical analysis authorized by the user; no new model generations or changes to frozen simulations or existing descriptive analyses
primary_descriptive: Equal-weight arithmetic mean of the two run-specific rates or word-macro accuracies; sample SD and both individual runs in supplement; never pooled counts presented as run means
count_model: Bayesian negative-binomial-2 log-link GLMM; 32 run x model x condition rows; log(messages) offset; 16 model-condition cell intercepts; random intercept for model x seed block (8 levels). Continuation includes only cycles 101-200; no duplicated baseline history.
count_priors: Cell log rates Normal(-2.5,1.5), block SD half-Normal(0,1), log NB shape Normal(log(10),1.5). Sensitivity: cell SD 2.5, random-effect SD scale 2, log shape SD 2.
semantic_model: Bayesian Bernoulli logit GLMM; all 1482 item-state responses; 16 model x task x context cells; crossed random intercepts for model x seed block, agent nested in block, expression, question item, and first-use case. Definition and scenario tasks modeled together, allowing task-specific fixed effects. No numerical run-level replication inferred from item count.
semantic_priors: Cell log odds Normal(1.5,2); random-effect SDs half-Normal(0,1). Sensitivity cell SD 3 and SD scale 2. Regularization handles perfect cells but ceiling estimates may depend on priors.
reporting: 12 count condition versus baseline rate ratios; 8 semantic use versus initial odds ratios; posterior medians, 95% equal-tailed credible intervals, posterior probability of an increase, clearly exploratory. No frequentist p-values or confirmatory significance declarations. Semantic item-weighted conditional OR is distinct from descriptive equal-run word-macro percentage point change.
diagnostics: 4 chains, 1000 warmup and 1000 retained per chain initially; Rhat <= 1.01 and bulk/tail ESS >= 400 targeted, zero divergences and no max-treedepth saturation. If failed increase warmup/draws or sampler settings without changing model or response selection; record changes. Posterior predictive checks of dispersion, count range, task/model accuracies, prior sensitivity for every contrast.
interpretation: Only two seed blocks per model and one added repetition; posterior uncertainty remains model/prior dependent. Conditional inference for fixed models/materials, not human behavior or population rankings. Do not equate semantic recognition with original utterance sense or acquisition; do not interpret continuation as pure causal time manipulation.
covariance_revision: During model review, add varying use-context slopes by model x seed and by expression to the semantic model, to avoid assuming identical context changes across seed blocks and expressions. Intercept-only fits retained as structural sensitivity, not discarded. This is an explicitly post hoc modeling addition, not a preregistration.
sampler_extension: Count wider-prior random-effect diagnostic Rhat=1.0126 exceeded the targeted 1.01. Extend retained sampling to 4000 draws per chain for both count prior settings, preserving model and priors; no new experimental data.
